708.author: Jianyu010
708.body:
Run selection is now durable and enforced at the host boundary. Requested configuration revision, resolved instructions and exact selected tool references survive duplicate/reopen; an empty set stays empty. Production Registry composition records pending admission and seals before any execution provider. A replacement Harness cannot expand model declarations or call hidden tools, and current host permission/enablement is rechecked at async and blocking-worker dispatch admission.

The shared types and scoped Store/Manager/Agent Service readers have one schema owner. Caller `selection_intent` is a versioned immutable input; server-policy `configuration_intent` is a separate first-admitted output. Default fingerprints remain compatible. Pinned-version failure, conflicting sealing and unavailable selected configuration fail without switching to current definitions. ModelCall remains a zero-tool host fast path: explicit selected instructions enter its actual system message, while its previous default request stays unchanged. The default registered Core consumes its selected prompt/declarations and rechecks ask_user authority at the existing backend question boundary.

`CurrentToolAuthority` provides synchronized global, owner and full-RunScope epochs. Scope denial removes model-visible declarations and blocks even a permissive provider; re-enablement does not restore an old live lease. Already-dispatched known results stay truthful. Cloud wires the existing real scoped Office permission ceiling into HostAPI; clarification is a distinct exact internal capability. This is not C3 Allow/Ask/Deny or a durable permission database.

Current head: `19870cae1ff909c0eb0b660892854c10dd9c6488`; production code is identical to reviewed `7ab3567cc98686c79f17cd65fabd2d217e6cf872`. Target: `codex/architecture-foundation`; latest incorporated foundation: `83494b97`. No C1/C3/C4/C5 unmerged implementation is included. Phone v35 is separate and contains none of this C2 activation/schema work.

Validation: **143 tests passed, zero failures/errors/skips**, Python 3.11.2, 4.997 s wall including imports. Real Registry/Router/Agent Service/Manager/file-backed SQLite/HostAPI participate; inference, ordinary tools and independent loops are explicitly controlled. Default-Core checks use the fixed read-only pinned-source checkout. Cases cover A/date vs B/zero, new-agent-after-startup, pending/sealed reopen, duplicate after edits, exact versions, schema/hidden-call injection, actual AS executor queue revocation, sibling isolation, started result preservation, ModelCall instructions and question revocation. The real question-inflight regression was red (new Q1 after revocation), then green (zero new interaction), with original answer/Stop/wrong-R cases preserved. A host-disabled counterexample lets the permissive provider enter once; restoring enforcement gives zero entry. Full module list/source-tree evidence is retained in the control log and summarized in docs/verification/run-selection-records.md. Independent QA completed against exact 7ab production. The original target Python 3.13.16 run retained 180 executions with three old-fixture errors; all other stages and independent public/no-Core probes passed. Fixture-only 19870cae changes no production blob and the original failing 30-case runtime stage then passed 30/30 with zero skips. This is scoped combined evidence, not a claim that all 180 reran on the new head. The original failed gate is retained.

**Activation / rollback gate: BLOCKED.** An actual exact-7f Store/AS probe ignores a sealed empty descriptor and enters a controlled date provider once. The new read-only target-image command (`python -m server.agent_service.selection_compatibility --database <same-state-db>`) reports capability `dm.run-selection.v1`; new-target/old-target and corrupt-format refusal are tested. Merely shipping this CLI does not protect an old executable. Platform activation/rollback must enforce the target-image preflight, same mount/image identity, and writer/admission quiescence. A supported rollback retains a compatible reader/enforcer and never attaches selection-v1 state to 7f or older execution code. No SQL trigger/layout trap, pinned-provider rewrite, phone pass, or complete same-S GC10 claim is made.

This is the pure identity contract for ADR-0008 only. It adds two files and does not change HostAPI dispatch, policy, Store, approvals or phone behavior. A hash is correlation data, not authority; filenames/URLs are not verified immutable content references. Actual C3 enforcement and durable Ask coordination await the published C2 selection/dispatch-ordering contract (#708) and the existing Store owner. 713.body:
Supplement seven E5 E2E cases for lifecycle and recovery. Refs #565.

| Case | What it checks | Observed result |
|---|---|---|
| BACKGROUND-01 | Return to the original task after 45 seconds in the background | PASS with the isolated Bridge and scripted model. Model progress occurred during the background interval. The original task completed, its reply returned, and the Bridge recorded one request before deduplication. |
| BACKGROUND-02 | Restore the original active task or pending question and its draft after display wake | PASS with the isolated Bridge and scripted model. Both drafts stayed unsent until the manual controls. Four requests reached Bridge ingress and produced four distinct completed tasks in the same room. The original question returned and received one accepted answer. |
| COLDSTART-01 | Restore the task, reply and unsent draft after process stop | PASS with the isolated Bridge and scripted model. The original task stayed running while the App process was absent. After relaunch, the original message, both reply paragraphs and the exact draft were present. The Bridge recorded one request before deduplication. The earlier flattened-text failure is linked in the results. |
| NETWORK-01 | Recover an in-flight task after disconnecting and reconnecting | Local E2E PASS on API 26. Airplane mode removed the OS default network and cut TLS reachability to the isolated Bridge during the original task. The App showed its offline prompt. The same task completed after restoration, and one control reply appeared. The Bridge recorded exactly two ingress requests, one original and one control. All seven assertions passed. |
| SILENCE-01 | Retain partial text while paused, after resuming and after a terminal error | FAIL reproduced. The earlier resume attempt completed. In the retest, 71 characters were visible before the stream was aborted. The same task failed, and the App showed the error with the partial text gone. The Bridge recorded one submission. |
| SWITCH-01 | Keep late replies in their original room | PASS. B completed before A was released. B stayed isolated after the App received A’s completion reminder. A’s reply appeared in A. |
| TIMEOUT-01 | Identify a real model timeout and retry the original task once | FAIL reproduced. WorkSwarm recorded a first-chunk timeout, but the App displayed a generic error. One native retry completed the same task. The original conversation showed one prompt, the bound reply and one retained historical error reply. The Bridge recorded one submission and one retry. |

**7 cases, 5 complete local passes and 2 failures.** Each pass covers one execution. GPT-6 Astra reviewed the BACKGROUND-01, BACKGROUND-02, COLDSTART-01 and SWITCH-01 screenshots and request records.

717.author: hlXia-mm
717.body:
上传 DOCX 后，默认助手因附件类型不支持而拒绝发送。本次在手机端提取正文和普通表格文字，以 UTF-8 TXT 附件复用现有云侧读取链路；界面保留原始 Word 的身份和真实原件预览，无需修改或部署云侧。

Closes #486

### 行为与实现
- 端侧检查 ZIP 格式并提取正文，验证 CRC、XML 声明及资源上限；兼容普通 Office 多命名空间、默认命名空间及 Strict OOXML，规避原生 getNamespace() 返回空值导致的误判。
- 云侧仅接收提取文本。草稿、发送后的卡片及冷启动恢复使用原 DOCX 名称、格式和大小；按端点及已验证账号隔离保存本机原件及 source_id 映射。
- 点击预览或保存时提供真实 DOCX 字节，不把 TXT 改名后冒充 Word。原件不可用时保留原文件信息并禁止打开；缓存内容版本区分原件与提取文本，避免复用旧 TXT 缓存。
- 普通文档分析请求附带“直接在对话中回答、除非用户明确要求导出否则不要额外生成报告文件”的要求，保留用户明确导出/保存结果文件的能力。不隐藏或删除已有的真实产物。此项属于发送给模型的任务要求，新的云侧完整问答仍需手动验收。
- 损坏、加密、纯图片、嵌套表格/文本框及超限输入给出中文提示；失败保留草稿，不静默截断正文。

### 边界
- 支持 `.docx` 正文和普通表格文字理解；旧版 `.doc`、图片 OCR、完整排版、页眉、批注及修订信息不在本次范围，PDF 处理不变。
- 输入上限 10 MiB；ZIP 条目 2048 个、声明解压总大小 32 MiB、正文 XML 2 MiB、提取文字 15000 字符；不向磁盘解压、不跟随外部关系，拒绝 DTD/实体声明。
- 本机原件按账号/端点隔离，缓存字节上限 100 MiB，元数据记录上限 1000 条；淘汰原件字节后仍保留 DOCX 卡片信息。原件未复制到云侧，跨设备或卸载重装后不保证原文件恢复；旧版上传的 TXT 记录无法自动还原原件，需重新上传。
- 不提交云侧代码、环境配置、签名材料或用户原始文档。回归样本的用户正文已替换。

### 验证
- 最新代码 Node 回归：207 个测试全部通过，涵盖提取、命名空间、上传、账号隔离、取消、附件卡片、冷启动恢复、原始字节预览/保存、普通发送及条件式结果输出要求。
- 最新代码鸿蒙模拟器原生 UT：6 个全部通过，包含原生解压/XML 解析、原件持久化冷启动、精确字节复制、索引更新及账号隔离。
- 原始《中秋节快乐.docx》此前已通过连接真机的文字提取验证；原始文件仅用于本地验证，不进入提交。
- Debug HAP 构建成功；最新版本已覆盖安装到连接的手机，保持 v0.1.8（10027）及云侧 20010。需要解锁手机后重新上传 DOCX 验收最新完整问答。

### 问题现场（修复前）
以下为 #486 原有现场截图。

![修复前：DOCX 上传后任务发送被拒绝](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/test-evidence-20261028/test-evidence/20261102/20261102_2306_docx_bad_params.jpg?raw=true)


### 用户真机验证截图（修复后）

原附件显示为 `中秋节快乐.docx`、`DOCX · 12.6 KB`，分析正文直接显示在对话中，截图所示结果未附加分析 TXT 文件。图中停止按钮的独立问题由 #719 / PR #720 跟踪，本 PR 不包含该修复。

![Word 修复后真机验证](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/7b88f5b7-75ac-4496-8ba9-4d3c628f2697)

718.author: Jianyu010
718.body:
This architecture slice applies one shared immutable host-hook contract at submission preflight, target admission, before-model and before-tool boundaries. Configured Deny prevents the corresponding dispatch; a tool refusal retains its call ID and executed=false without inventing an execution record. It adds an opt-in ModelCall answer-delta path and a no-budget physical-attempt accounting port/orchestrator.

The successful live experiment uses an authorized DeepSeek provider through the existing LiteLLM management forward: actual ModelGateway/OpenAI SSE → HostAPI → public AS/real execution SQLite → application collector. At exact 90e0e3cc, 127 genuine deltas arrive in order and concatenate to the durable final; the first arrives 1.359 seconds before the actual HTTP SSE DONE marker. Reported usage is 30 input + 277 output tokens. Currency/rate provenance is absent, so structured cost remains unknown. This is an application collector, not phone streaming.

A frozen real-provider sample exposed normal observer-tail loss. The unchanged strict assertion also failed deterministically through the real AS observer (01 != 01234). The fix drains an already queued healthy tail within 50 ms; slow/failing/overflow/cancelled consumers still detach. One real-provider retest after that fix passed. Original failure and controlled red/green evidence are retained; no buffered final is split into synthetic deltas.

Current exact 29a362e0 additionally retains known usage through original cancellation and timeout/error wrappers without returning the interrupted answer. The successful live-provider sample remains attributed to source90; the error-path increment has controlled component proof, not a new live request.

Validation at exact29a: 147 affected local Python3.11.2 tests pass, zero failures/skips, including fixed-source Core question regression. The actual Python3.13.16 target gate passes99 distinct tests with OSexit0 and zero skips. Full281-entry git inventory includes12 zero-byte files; SHA/size/extracted modes match, and76 actual server/plugins imports resolve exclusively under current source. A heavy import-scanning evidence runner initially failed1+2 timing tests; that failure remains retained. Corrected constant-overhead module-load tracing passed unchanged assertions. Three target runs are297 executions of99 distinct tests, not297 distinct passes.

Eleven component STs cover early deltas, four-stage scope, refusal, pre-admission and model denial, explicit trusted targets, duplicate/evidence idempotency/reopen, slow observers, cancelled execution with late usage, Stop during observer drain, and actual-AS wrapped timeout usage. No late answer or reopened run is introduced.

This remains partial architecture verification under df75e7cf, dependent on C2 #708 and C1 #712 (merged exact 56fb241a), plus descriptor #709. Real components: Router/AS/Host/Gateway/execution Manager/SQLite. Substitutes: trusted validation authority, deterministic classifier and TEST-ONLY SQLite accounting port. No production Store/Manager/schema, budget balance, phone or deployed-image changes. Default paid Router/Proximity/BGE Allow is not connected to the shared before-model/attempt port; preflight Deny provider0 does not pass that coverage. Dynamic admission policy linearization, durable Ask, production accounting/shutdown drain, actual pinned-Core refusal continuation, AgentCall Harness streaming and full first-journey acceptance remain explicit gaps. C3-specific commits: ce3a313a through 48545093, db6b8847, 90e0e3cc and interrupted-usage increments through29a362e0; inherited dependency changes are not a second Store implementation.

723.author: Jianyu010
723.body:
Architecture experiment ARC-CONTEXT-BIND-01 separates durable same-session input receipts from execution-context binding for fresh text-only turns. A held A can complete while pre-stopped B is retained once and C is durably admitted without entering a provider. After quiescent reopen, an explicit retry executes the same C once using A's committed prefix.

Head `b3d555c3`; base `codex/architecture-foundation`. Dependency: #712 exact `56fb241a` (includes #708 `19870cae`). The change relative to that dependency is **only four new files in experiments/context_bind/**; no production source, normal/cloud/mobile composition, accepted spec or main branch is modified. Draft architecture evidence only: do not merge to main or activate this DB dialect in production.

The opt-in candidate subclasses the real SQLite Store and Manager. It introduces explicit version1 pending/bound context state and NULL pending snapshots without repurposing attachment input_ready. Immutable submissions.payload remains the sole input authority. Receipt/claim/read overrides are experimental; current Registry/ProfileLoader, Manager identity/fingerprint/control policy, Router ingress, Runtime/AS, C2 sealing, Host context/model gates and atomic final/CAS are real reused components. The model/Harness and next-C retry driver are controlled fixtures, not another execution authority or scheduler.

Validation: native Python 3.11.2 with fixed-source Core, **45 tests passed, zero failures/errors/skips**: six new experiment ST plus existing Runtime/different-S cancellation, F2/F3 and selection regressions. Two independent SQLite connections contend at a barrier with exactly one claimed and one queued; stale final CAS is rejected. Tests cover same M duplicate/conflict, owner scope, B pre-Stop and queued Stop, zero B/C entry while A runs, pending snapshot failure, close/reopen, same C/S/R/configuration, prefix/final revisions1→2→3→4, Stop(B) while C is active, and final committed/lost ACK idempotency. The baseline against the current Store retained a real red: B changed A's revision1→2. Evidence: control/arc-context-bind-baseline-red.log and control/arc-context-bind-native.log. Independent review and delivery Python3.13 remain pending.

Explicit fixture policy: never-applied cancelled B stays in product receipt history and is not automatically applied to later execution context. This is not accepted main product policy. Previously bound inputs are not reordered. No FIFO guarantee, active orphan recovery, automatic scheduler, steering, pre-admission Ask, attachments, production migration/rollback hook or budget service is implemented. A legacy DB is rejected. README specifies minimal integration needs and checkpoint/final versus host-journal interface constraints only; no fifth HostAPI or post-Stop execution privilege is added.

This updates the existing authoritative ledger to distinguish foundation behavior, unmerged C1–C5/PRE-R/ARC experiments, real versus substituted actors, original failures versus controlled replays, and accepted requirements versus unresolved policy.

Base: df75e7cfb4929ee7e60d7121992525a7319694cb. Head: 55ddc056 (documentation only). C1/C2 scoped fixes, C3 ModelCall streaming, PRE-R null-usage replay and ARC receipt/context feasibility retain their exact source and evidence limits. Independent steering source review and a controlled repeat confirm the missing durable intake/consumption seam (13 source-blob hashes and five frozen artifacts verified): RAM applied acknowledgement is not durable intake/consumption evidence, absent-input Stop(B) is correctly pending, and a late successor R2 remains proposed. Independent checkpoint review confirms a bounded default-main preservation adapter/contract gap, not an ownership violation or fundamental four-operation blocker; the existing one-staging behavior follows the accepted lifecycle. Explicit checkpoint/history and Stop-retention decisions remain necessary before a feature-preserving default swap. The historical 028fedc0 full suite is not inherited as a full df75 gate.

Validation: git diff --check; Python checks for 14 resolving local Markdown links, balanced fences, no private absolute paths, one authorized changed file, and explicit steering/full-suite evidence scope. The five steering freeze-manifest artifact hashes matched. Component/provider/target/device suites were not rerun for this documentation change.

Production accounting/budgets, durable supplement consumption, AgentCall/consumer streaming, activation/rollback guards, checkpoint semantics and full phone parity remain separate gaps. No implementation, deployment, issue creation or main merge is included.

728.author: hlXia-mm
728.body:
Closes #727.

Fast account recovery could remove StartupSplash immediately, while startup_pet.webp was still playing. Authenticated gateway callbacks could also navigate directly to chat before the animation completed.

The splash now reports completion after a 900ms presentation window starting at successful image decoding. The window matches the resource's 27 ANMF frame durations. Recovery-driven dismissal and automatic chat navigation respect that state. Reduced motion and decode errors complete immediately; background handling, explicit routes and the existing eight-second escape remain intact. Playback timers are canceled on disappearance and repeated image decode events do not restart the window.

Validation:
- On base main e48edbf8, a regression test using the actual production methods fails: signed-out recovery hides the splash with playback still incomplete. The same test passes after this change.
- 103 related Node tests passed: startup presentation/playback, gateway UI, account login scenarios and About You lifecycle. Tests also check actual WebP frame duration, duplicate decode events, timer disposal, reduced motion and early authenticated navigation.
- HarmonyOS debug assembleApp: BUILD SUCCESSFUL. The unsigned debug HAP was installed over the existing app on emulator 127.0.0.1:5555, without uninstalling or clearing its data. Launch reaches the login screen.
- Build-only version/signing/config overlays are excluded from this commit.

Visual evidence from UCD (original screenshot in #727):

![UCD splash](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/2cf822592c864ad096f2ce08449425c0aaf649ee/docs/issue-evidence/ucd-20261107/row14-splash.png?raw=true)

It shows the fully visible mascot and DigitalMate wordmark on the phone splash screen, unlike the partial mascot in the original UCD report. The playback overlay reads 00:02 / 00:05. This attachment is a still image from playback, not the original video.

![Post-fix phone validation: complete mascot and DigitalMate wordmark](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/c3d63b23e0850e7d6aae9c5d0e7c1bed12248e41/docs/issue-evidence/ucd-20261107/row14-splash-fixed-phone.jpg?raw=true)

Limitations: the still image documents the post-fix visual state; it does not independently establish frame-by-frame timing. Continuous playback, authenticated startup, first-run and reduced-motion device acceptance remain pending. The PR remains draft.
